y-m-67-07.topic: Izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlukanisa: i-second derivative namaphoyinti okuguquka
y-m-67-07.goal: Khombisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi umbandela f″(a)=0 wodwa awenzi iphoyinti libe yiphoyinti lokuguquka, bese usho wena ukuthi yini okufanele uyihlole ukuze libe yiphoyinti lokuguquka.
y-m-67-07.material:
Cabanga ngomsebenzi f(x) = xⁿ (n yinombolo yemvelo engu-3 noma ngaphezulu). I-second derivative ngu-f″(x) = n(n−1)xⁿ⁻² futhi f″(0) = 0. (Funda f″ njengo-f double prime.) Iphoyinti lokuguquka liyiphoyinti lapho igophe lishintsha phakathi kwe-concave ne-convex, okungukuthi, iphoyinti lapho uphawu lwe-f″ lushintsha khona. y-m-67-09.goal: Qinisekisa ukuthi ubude bokubala bungahluka kuye ngendlela ukhetha ngayo u no-v′ ekuhlanganiseni ngezingxenye, nokuthi ngisho nendlela ebukeka njengokwehluleka inika umphumela ofanayo uma yenziwa lula, bese ubhala isizathu sokukhetha kwakho.
y-m-67-09.material: Abafundi ababili bazama ukuthola i-indefinite integral ∫ x ln x dx (x>0; ifundwa: i-integral ye-x izikhathi i-natural logarithm ka-x, ngokuphathelene no-x) ngokuhlanganisa ngezingxenye, ∫u v′ dx = uv − ∫u′ v dx. UJihu uvumela u = ln x no-v′ = x, noHaeun uvumela u = x no-v′ = ln x. (Cabanga ukuthi usuvele wazi ukuthi i-indefinite integral ye-ln x ngu-x ln x − x. I-constant yokuhlanganisa ibhalwa njengo-C.)

y-m-67-05.goal: Hlola ifomula yokwehlukanisa ekhonjiwe ngezinombolo, ncipha ububanzi buka-a onou-m(a)=1 usebenzisa ithebula, futhi uxhumanise ukuthi leli nani ngu-e nokuthi u-(aˣ)′ = aˣ ln a.

y-m-67-05.prereq.2: Ukuthi igrafu yomsebenzi we-exponential u-aˣ ibushelelezi
y-m-67-05.s.s1.prompt: USubin wakhumbula u-(aˣ)′ = x·aˣ⁻¹. Ukufaka u-x=0 kule fomula kunika u-m(a)=0. Kodwa uma u-a=2, u-(2ʰ−1)/h ungu-0.718, 0.696, 0.693 cishe ku-h=0.1, 0.01, 0.001. Wawuhlulela kanjani ifomula kaSubin?
y-m-67-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funda kushintsho lwezinombolo ukuthi inani liya kuphi njengoba u-h encipha ku-0.1, 0.01, 0.001.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.hint.1: Beka inani elivela ekufakeni u-x=0 efomulweni kaSubin eceleni kwamanani asethebuleni futhi uwaqhathanise.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.a: U-0.693 useduze no-0, ngakho ifomula kaSubin ingabhekwa njengelungile.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.a: Ubone ukuthambekela lokuthi noma u-h encishiswa, inani alihambi ku-0 kodwa lihlala eduze no-0.693?
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.b: Amanani asethebuleni ahlala eduze no-0.69, ngakho le fomula ayilungile.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde njengobufakazi ukuthi lapho u-h encishiswa, inani linamathela enombolweni ethile ephozithivu esikhundleni sika-0.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.o.c: U-h akasiyo u-0, ngakho ithebula alinamqondo, futhi kufanele sithembe ifomula ekhonjiwe.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.r.c: I-derivative yinani lapho u-h esondela ku-0. Ithebula liwubufakazi obuya kuleli nani.
y-m-67-05.s.s1.explain: Noma u-h encishiswa, inani liqoqana eduze no-0.693, hhayi u-0. Ngakho ku-x=0, ifomula kaSubin u-x·aˣ⁻¹ = 0 ayihambisani nokuthambeka komugqa othintayo ku-a=2.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.prompt: Hamba ufune u-a onou-m(a)=1. Hlola isahlulelo sakho ngenkathi ubheka idatha ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, sho emgqeni owodwa ukuthi idatha entsha isekela noma iphikisa isiqagelo sakho.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.hint.1: Beka inani elisethebuleni nenani luka-ln a eceleni kuka-a ofanayo futhi uqhathanise ukuthi umehluko mkhulu kangakanani.

y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Phakathi kuka-2 no-3, futhi kubonakala useduze no-3.

y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Phakathi kuka-3 no-4. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi u-m(3) usayaswela ku-1.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.r.c: m(3)≈1.099 usedlulile ku-1. Bheka lapho kuqala khona ukudlula u-1.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.0.o.d: Konke ongakusho ukuthi kuphakathi kuka-2 no-3.

y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Kubonakala liphakathi kuka-2.7 no-2.8, kodwa inani eliyiyo alikwazi ukumiswa ngethebula.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Lokhu kunciphise ububanzi kuyilapho kuvuma umkhawulo wethebula.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Inani elingu-1 ngqo alikho ethebuleni, ngakho akukho a enjalo
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.1.r.c: m(a) ishintsha ngokuqhubekayo no-a, ngakho inani elingekho ethebuleni alisho ukuthi alikho.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.info: Inombolo lapho m(a)=1 ibizwa ngo-e, futhi e ≈ 2.71828…. Futhi m(a) = ln a (i-natural logarithm ka-a), ngakho (aˣ)′ = aˣ ln a. Uma uqhathanisa nethebula, ln 2 ≈ 0.693, ln 3 ≈ 1.099, ln 2.7 ≈ 0.993.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.ask: Ifomula yokuqala kaSubin iqhathaniswa kanjani nalo mphumela?
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.after: Ku-x=0, ifomula kaSubin ihlala ingu-0, kodwa i-slope yangempela ingu-ln a. Uma a≠1, khona-ke ln a≠0, ngakho ifomula kaSubin ayilungile. m(a)=1 uma ln a=1, okungukuthi, a=e.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Ifomula kaSubin ingabhekwa njengelungile ku-x=0 kuphela uma a=e.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Uma a=e khona-ke m=1, kodwa ifomula kaSubin inika u-0 ku-x=0. Hlola ukuthi isalungile yini.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Amanani asethebuleni afana namanani e-ln a kuwukuhlangana nje.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Kunzima ukubona njengokuhlangana ukuthi wonke amathathu avumelana kuze kube yindawo yesithathu yedesimali.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Ku-x=0, ifomula kaSubin inika u-0 futhi inani langempela ngu-ln a (≠0), ngakho ifomula ayilungile.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Uqinisekise ngesisho ukungahambisani ithebula lezinombolo elakukhombisa.
y-m-67-05.s.s2.reflect: Ukulandelana bekungu: ekuqaleni ukwethemba ifomula ekhunjuliwe, ukuyiphikisa ngezinombolo, ukunciphisa ububanzi ngethebula, bese incazelo (e) nesisho esichaza ithebula. Ukuzethemba kwakho kwashintsha esinyathelweni sini? Lokho ithebula elakwenza kuhluke kanjani kulokho isisho esakwenza?
